fullPassage: It was two hours before the submission deadline and I still hadn't finished my news article. I sat at the desk, but suddenly, the typewriter didn't work. No matter how hard I tapped the keys, the levers wouldn't move to strike the paper. I started to realize that I would not be able to finish the article on time. Desperately, I rested the typewriter on my lap and started hitting each key with as much force as I could manage. Nothing happened. Thinking something might have happened inside of it, I opened the cover, lifted up the keys, and found the problem — a paper clip. The keys had no room to move. After picking it out, I pressed and pulled some parts. The keys moved smoothly again. I breathed deeply and smiled. Now I knew that I could finish my article on time.

det.tip: 조동사 + have + 과거분사(happened)

questions.passage: It was two hours before the submission deadline and I still hadn't finished my news article. I sat at the desk, but suddenly, the typewriter didn't work. No matter how hard I tapped the keys, the levers wouldn't move to strike the paper. I started to realize that I would not be able to finish the article on time. Desperately, I rested the typewriter on my lap and started hitting each key with as much force as I could manage. Nothing happened. Thinking something might have happened inside of it, I opened the cover, lifted up the keys, and found the problem — a paper clip. The keys had no room to move. After picking it out, I pressed and pulled some parts. The keys moved smoothly again. I breathed deeply and smiled. Now I knew that I could finish my article on time.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 마감 직전 타자기 고장을 해결한 경험이 주제
det.analysis:
❌ ① 타자기 작동 원리: 본문에 없음
❌ ② 기사 작성법: 본문에 없음
✅ ③ 마감 직전 타자기 고장을 해결하고 위기를 극복한 경험: 종이 클립을 찾아 고장을 해결 ← 정답
❌ ④ 종이 클립 활용법: 본문과 무관
det.tip: 핵심: 마감 직전 타자기 고장 → 원인 발견 → 해결

ch: 마감 직전 타자기 고장을 해결하고 위기를 극복한 경험

questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 원인을 찾으면 위기를 해결할 수 있다는 요지
det.analysis:
❌ ① 손으로 쓰기: 요지 아님

❌ ③ 마감 준수: 세부 교훈
✅ ④ 마감 직전 닥친 예상치 못한 문제도 침착히 원인을 찾으면 해결할 수 있다: 고장의 원인(종이 클립)을 찾아 해결 ← 정답
det.tip: 요지: 원인을 찾으면 위기 극복 가능

다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 맞게 영작하시오.

내가 키를 아무리 세게 두드려도

[조건] (1) hard, how, I, keys, matter, No, tapped, the를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 8단어로 쓸 것 (영어로)

det.korean: No matter how hard I tapped the keys
det.analysis:
본문: 'No matter how hard I tapped the keys, the levers wouldn't move' — 양보 부사절 No matter how + 부사(hard) + 주어 + 동사(tapped)

[조건 검증] No(1) matter(2) how(3) hard(4) I(5) tapped(6) the(7) keys(8) = 8단어
det.tip: No matter how + 형/부 + 주어 + 동사 = 아무리 ~해도
